name: Gemini 3 Deep Think
description: Gemini 3 Deep Think is an inference-time compute-scaling reasoning mode integrated within Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 model family. It generates internal step-by-step reasoning chains, evaluates parallel hypothesis paths, and performs self-verification to solve complex multi-step problems in mathematics, physics, materials science, and software engineering.
keyFeatures: Inference-Time Compute Scaling: Dynamically allocates test-time compute for extended internal reasoning and self-verification
Parallel Hypothesis Search: Explores multiple candidate solution trees concurrently to avoid local optima in multi-step problems
Configurable Thinking Depth: Allows tuning of reasoning depth, cost, and latency via API parameters like thinking_level
Agentic Workflows & Tool Integration: Seamlessly combines search synthesis, code execution, and tool usage with minimized hallucinations
High-Rigor Scientific Capabilities: Excels at complex domain tasks including Olympiad-level mathematics, physics, and materials science
curatorNotes: Verified release from Google DeepMind. Specialized inference-time compute scaling mode.
